title: Enterprise Multi-Tenant Vector Database Isolation & Sharding (5,000 Tenants / 100M Vectors) Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Single Monolithic HNSW Graph + Scalar Filter (WHERE tenant_id = X)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 0.005% selectivity disconnects HNSW graph traversal (54% recall, 640ms P99)

tiers.name: Tier 2: 5,000 Separate Physical Collections / HNSW Indexes
tiers.verdict: Metadata Explosion: 5,000 x 300MB fixed index/WAL overhead wastes 1.5TB RAM ($168K/mo)

tiers.name: Tier 3: Dedicated Micro-Cluster Instance per Tenant
tiers.verdict: Prohibitive $245K/mo minimum instance tax across 4,900 mostly idle small tenants

tiers.name: Tier 4: Partition-Key Co-Located Sub-Graphs (4,900 Tenants) + Dedicated VIP Shards (100 Whales) + Cold NVMe
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 98.4% recall, 18ms P99, 240GB RAM (-88.8% vs Tier 2) & $14.5K/mo (-91.4% TCO)
